name: Rune-carved Key of Belegost
description: A heavy key of black iron, its bow worked with dwarven runes. It was made for one door, and that door lies somewhere below.

name: Seal of Angmar
description: A seal of cold black stone on a chain, heavy with the malice of the Witch-king. It lends strength and speed to whoever wears it, and once worn it will not be put off; it calls to every evil thing near. Only the fire that made such things can unmake it.

name: Hilt-shard of the Broken Blade
description: The hilt and a hand's breadth of a great sword of the First Age, the steel still bright where it broke.

name: Blade-shard of the Broken Blade
description: The middle of a great sword, broken at both ends, runes running along its fuller.

name: Point-shard of the Broken Blade
description: The point of a great sword, still keen enough to cut the hand that holds it carelessly.

name: Reforged Blade~
description: The broken blade, made whole again in the town's forge and given the powers you chose for it.

name: Phial~ of the Water of Ulmo
description: A phial of water drawn from a spring the Lord of Waters is said to have blessed. Poured out on a profaned altar, it will hallow it again.

name: Sealed Letter
description: A letter folded tight and sealed with plain red wax, addressed in a careful hand: "To the hermit below the town, and to no other."

name: Opened Letter
description: The letter for the hermit, its seal broken. You know what it says now.

name: Torn Journal Page~
description: A page torn from the Black Market's own ledger, with notes in the margin about whoever has been robbing it.

name: Black Market Strongbox
description: An iron strongbox, still locked, stamped with the mark of the town's Black Market.

name: Warden's Taper~
description: A long taper of blessed wax that never quite goes out. With it the old wardens lit the fires that kept the Shade of the Stair in its place.

name: Heart of the Mountain
description: A great white jewel that seems to hold a light of its own. It was the heart of Belegost's treasury. Worn, it lends strength and endurance, and dragons dream of it; they will come.

name: Palantír~
description: A seeing-stone of the Faithful: a ball of dark crystal that shows what is far away. Looked into, it shows this whole level and all that's on it. Something else looks into the stones too.

name: Sack~ of Holding
description: A plain sack, larger inside than out. Carried in your pack, it lets you carry a quarter as much again before you're slowed. Only the best bag you carry counts.

name: Bag~ of Holding
description: A leather bag stitched with silver runes, far larger inside than out. Carried in your pack, it lets you carry half as much again before you're slowed, and holds two more things. Only the best bag you carry counts; if it's lost, what it held spills out.

name: Bag~ of Holding
description: A leather bag stitched with silver runes, far larger inside than out. Carried in your pack, it lets you carry half as much again before you're slowed, and holds two more things. Only the best bag you carry counts; if it's lost, what it held spills out.

name: Greater Bag~ of Holding
description: A bag of midnight-blue cloth that seems to hold a whole room. Carried in your pack, it lets you carry twice as much before you're slowed, and holds four more things. Only the best bag you carry counts; if it's lost, what it held spills out.

name: Pair~ of Leather Bracers
description: Stiff leather bracers with a single setting for a gem. Worn on the arms, beside your gloves. Set a gem in it (from the gem's menu, or the bracers'); only an armourer can take one out.

name: Pair~ of Iron Bracers
description: Heavy iron bracers with two settings for gems. Worn on the arms, beside your gloves. Set gems in them (from a gem's menu, or the bracers'); only an armourer can take one out.

name: Pair~ of Mithril Bracers
description: Light, bright mithril bracers with three settings for gems. Worn on the arms, beside your gloves. Set gems in them (from a gem's menu, or the bracers'); only an armourer can take one out.

name: Chipped Ruby~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of fire and fury: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Ruby~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of fire and fury: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Ruby~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of fire and fury: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Chipped Sapphire~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of cold and guarding: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Sapphire~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of cold and guarding: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Sapphire~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of cold and guarding: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Chipped Topaz~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of lightning and a sure hand: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Topaz~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of lightning and a sure hand: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Topaz~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of lightning and a sure hand: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Chipped Emerald~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of health: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Emerald~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of health: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Emerald~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of health: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Chipped Diamond~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of hardness: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Diamond~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of hardness: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Diamond~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of hardness: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Chipped Opal~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of clear sight: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Opal~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of clear sight: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Opal~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of clear sight: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Chipped Amethyst~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of a clear mind: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Amethyst~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of a clear mind: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Amethyst~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of a clear mind: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Chipped Garnet~
description: A chipped stone, its power faint. A gem of strength: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Flawed Garnet~
description: A flawed stone, of middling power. A gem of strength: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Garnet~
description: A flawless stone, full of power. A gem of strength: set in bracers, it lends them its virtue. Only an armourer can take it out again.

name: Bloodstone~
description: A dark green stone flecked with red, warm to the touch. Set in bracers, it lends great strength and endurance.

name: Black Onyx~
description: A stone as black as a moonless night. Set in bracers, it lets you move like a shadow and see in the dark.

name: Star Sapphire~
description: A blue stone with a six-rayed star that seems to move within it. Set in bracers, it quickens you.

name: Flask~ of Venom Oil
description: A thick green oil. Rubbed on a weapon (or your hands), it makes your blows poison for a while; creatures that resist poison shrug it off.

name: Flask~ of Burning Oil
description: An oil that catches without a flame. On a weapon it burns what you strike for a while.

name: Flask~ of Frost Oil
description: A bitter, ice-cold oil. On a weapon it freezes what you strike for a while.

name: Flask~ of Storm Oil
description: An oil that crackles in the flask. On a weapon it shocks what you strike for a while.

name: Flask~ of Corrosive Oil
description: A fuming oil, kept in glass. On a weapon it dissolves what you strike for a while.

name: Phial~ of Holy Water
description: Water blessed by the priests of the town. Sprinkled on a weapon, it smites evil creatures for a while.

name: Dwarven Lamp~
description: A squat iron lamp of the Longbeards, lit by a stone that never burns down. It needs no oil, and its steady light shows the grain of the rock: you dig a little better by it.

name: Elven Lantern~
description: A slender silver lantern of the Eldar, filled with a soft grey light that needs no oil and draws no eye. You move a little more quietly by it.

name: Miner's Helm~
description: A dented iron cap with a candle-cup on the brow, worn in the mines of the Blue Mountains. It lights a little way ahead, and the knack of it helps you dig.

name: Set~ of Delver's Gloves
description: Thick, scarred gloves of hide with iron studs across the knuckles, made for pulling stone. They help you dig.

name: Red Dragon Scale~
description: A scale from a red dragon's hide, still warm. The Armoury can work it into a piece of your armour, which then resists fire.

name: White Dragon Scale~
description: A scale from a white dragon's hide, rimed with frost. The Armoury can work it into a piece of your armour, which then resists cold.

name: Blue Dragon Scale~
description: A scale from a blue dragon's hide, that crackles when touched. The Armoury can work it into a piece of your armour, which then resists lightning.

name: Black Dragon Scale~
description: A scale from a black dragon's hide, pitted and reeking. The Armoury can work it into a piece of your armour, which then resists acid.

name: Green Dragon Scale~
description: A scale from a green dragon's hide, faintly sickly. The Armoury can work it into a piece of your armour, which then resists poison.

name: Troll Hide~
description: A tough grey strip of troll hide, that knits itself together when cut. Worked into armour by the Armoury, it lends you the troll's healing.

name: Skein~ of Spider Silk
description: A skein of black-grey silk from a great spider's spinnerets, that drinks the light. Worked into armour by the Armoury, it resists darkness.
